entry_state: General measurement separates future coverage,incurred claims,risk adjustment and unearned profit. The connected profitable group,onerous group and treaty reconcile at intermediate dates as well as terminal cash. Loss and recovery components sit within their measured balances. Atomic publication now requires the complete declared group set,valid component calculations and matching journals;replay details continue next.
exit_state: Insurance event retries preserve the original receipt and distinguish unknown transport outcome from accounting state. PAA coverage eligibility,service-to-premium timing and claim settlement use different clocks. Reinsurance and direct participation need their own evidence. The guarantee example derives a market price9 versus physical expected top-up4.5,and introduces a complete insurance group with financial benefit99,mortality2,risk adjustment1 and CSM8;its subsequent path continues next.
findings: Historical receipt lookup follows eligibility validation;an exact retry does not reset today's head or repeat the accounting. Finite examples do not establish storage durability.
One-year PAA coverage does not justify omitting discounting on a claim due two years after incurrence. Acquisition-cost election and claim-incurrence finance rate remain separately consequential.
A fixed90% participation share does not make the retained payoff linear when a minimum benefit binds. The settlement table shows a funding shortfall without presenting it as a valuation.
The replication derivation defines asset units,cash holdings and positive state-price conditions before distinguishing pricing weights from physical probabilities. No new confirmed local defect.
